Hello! I currently am struggling with the qSprite plugin and possibly the editor. I have gone over the plugins github many times and the plugins descriptions, but I cannot for the life of me figure out how to get my sprite to show in game. It shows fine in the editor, but when I use a plugin command to make the sprite/pose show, it does not show in game. I will answer any questions on what I did wrong and post screenshots if needed!!!
I have tried clearing, renaming, redoing everything. But nothing seems to work.
I am trying to make my character have a shaking animation from falling. It shows correctly in the editor. I am making a cutscene btw!
I have the file name for the image named "%Nienna-fallstand"
Maybe I have to rename it, but I have tried every name I can think would work and it doesn't. If anyone has any suggestions, let me know!
(EDIT): I did add the idle and move poses. That could have been the reason why it was invisible, but now it just won't animate!!! I am struggling haha

I haven't used this plug-in or editor before, so I did a google search to see what it says about errors and found this. Not sure if this helps or not but good luck!
If QSprite characters aren't working in RPG Maker, it's usually a setup issue: check your file naming (using % or Q_ prefixes correctly), ensure your sprite sheets match the editor's configuration (no blank spaces, correct dimensions), enable the plugin, and verify no other plugins conflict, especially with dash animations or default naming conventions.
Always refer to the official QSprite documentation and editor setup guide
, as it's complex and requires precise configuration.
Common Solutions:
File Naming & Prefixes:
Check your prefix:
The default is %, but if you changed it to Q_, your filenames must match (e.g., %Alex.png or Q_Alex.png).
Correct Format:
Use the $MyCharacter.png format for standard 4x3 sheets or the !MyCharacter.png for split sheets if needed.
Case Sensitive:
Names are case-sensitive (e.g., idle vs. Idle), so be precise.
QSprite Editor Setup:
Match the Editor:
Ensure your sprite sheet's configuration (number of frames, rows, etc.) in the QSprite Editor exactly matches the actual file and your plugin parameters.
No Blank Spaces:
Blank spaces in your spritesheet can cause flashing or errors when the plugin switches frames, check for empty frames and fix them.
